items.statement: A redesigned pathway (combined consent with a staining photograph, a need-ordered call list and a staining leaflet) will raise the proportion of children with active cavities who receive SDF soon after screening from about 41 percent to at least 60 percent, without widening the gap by home language.
items.rationale: Targets the consent bottleneck (c1, c2) and clinic flow (c4); the equity condition is part of the proposition because of c5.
items.risks: Board approval of the form may be delayed; seasonal absence.

items.statement: Parents who see a staining photograph before consenting will more often consent to SDF on back teeth and decline it on front teeth, and will describe the decision as their own.
items.rationale: Follows parents' wish to see a photograph first (c3); explored in the conversation strand.
items.risks: Conversations may reach mostly fluent, engaged parents.

summary: h1 selected for the measurement strand; h2 guides the conversation strand.
